sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Reject: the conditional SPARQL branches still bind an arbitrary structural member on the ship, so applicability for plasticNeutralAxisHeight and both interpolation endpoints is not paired to the relevant calculation case and its local-frame section case/member. Preserve the prior owner corrections, COMPLEX_READINESS boundary, exact area comparison (100*A_fn > 1000*t_pn*s), and strict oblique interval 20 < framingAngleOmega < 70.
